γαιήοχε: γαιήοχος — earth-holder, earth-carrier (epithet of Poseidon); masc. voc. sg.; the verb behind -οχος (ἔχω ’hold’ or ὀχέω ’bear, carry’) is debated
δαίνυται: δαίνυμαι — feast, dine on; pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’feasts on’
διὲκ: διέκ — out through, right through; prep. + gen. (διά + ἐκ, epic)
εἰλήλουθεν: ἔρχομαι — come, go; perf. 3 sg., epic εἰλήλουθεν (= Attic ἐλήλυθε): ’has come’
κέλετο: κέλομαι — urge on, bid, command; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐκέλετο)
καταπρηνέσσ: καταπρηνής — bent forward, flat, palm down (said of a hand); fem. dat. pl., epic -έσσι (= Attic -έσι), elided
οἷα: οἷος — such as, of what kind; neut. acc. pl., relative: ’such (things) as’
οὔατ: οὖς — ear; neut. acc. pl., elided, epic οὔατα (= Attic ὦτα)
πιφαύσκεται: πιφαύσκω — make known, declare; pres. mid. 3 sg.
προθύρου: πρόθυρον — forecourt, gateway before the house-door; neut. gen. sg. in -ου (epic -οιο), gen. of separation
προτέρην: πρότερος — earlier, first; fem. acc. sg.: ’first’, before another
τετύχθαι: τεύχω — make, bring to pass; perf. pass. inf.: ’to have come to be’
ψυχρὴ: ψυχρός — cold; adj., fem. nom. sg.
ἀπηνής: ἀπηνής — harsh, rough, unfeeling; masc. nom. sg., with νόος
ἀπόλωλε: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy; mid./pass. perish; perf. 3 sg.: ’has perished and is gone’
ἐλεύσεσθαι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; fut. inf. mid.
ἐννοσίγαιον: ἐννοσίγαιος — earth-shaker (epithet of Poseidon); masc. acc. sg. as a noun
ἐχολώσατο: χολόομαι — be angry, grow wroth; aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’grew angry’
ἔρχεσθαι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. inf.: ’to go’ · also pres. inf. used as imperative: ’go!’ (ἔρχεσθαι δή ’go then’)
ἰάνθη: ἰαίνω — warm, gladden, cheer; aor. pass. 3 sg.: ’was warmed, was gladdened’
ἰόντ: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἰόντ’ = ἰόντα): ’as he went’
ἴδησθε: εἶδον (aor. of ὁράω) — see; aor. subj. mid. 2 pl., in a generalizing temporal clause: ’when you see’ · also aor. subj. mid. 2 pl. in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’so that you may see’
ὀλυμπίου: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian, of Olympus; masc. gen. sg.
ὄλωλε: ὄλλυμι — destroy; perf. intr. 3 sg.: ’stands ruined, is lost’
